text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Each day, they hold quick meetings known as standups to discuss progress and problems. The work is organised in a backlog, a list of tasks and user stories that describe what users need. Teams develop the product iteratively, meaning they build it step by step and improve it after each sprint. This approach helps teams respond to changes quickly and deliver value to customers sooner.
